description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying invoice details for a specific shop and invoice. It includes static generation functions and a React component that fetches invoice data via a client component.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static parameters for the page, returning combinations of shop IDs and invoice IDs.

methods.name: ShopInvoiceDetailPage
methods.description: Main React component that decodes URL parameters and renders the invoice detail client component.
